profile.name: Binder MK 53 气候箱
profile.description: Binder MK 53 是一款实验室气候箱/环境试验箱，用于在受控温度条件下放置样品并进行培养、预处理或稳定性测试。该设备具备温度设定与监测功能，并可反馈门状态和运行模式等基本状态信息。
profile.description_en: The Binder MK 53 is a laboratory climate chamber used to hold samples under controlled temperature conditions for incubation, conditioning, and stability testing. It supports temperature setpoint control and monitoring, and provides basic status information such as door state and operating mode.

registry.name: BINDER GmbH Binder MK 53 climate chamber
registry.description: Binder Mk53是由BINDER GmbH生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括写入数据、初始化、打开、温度设置、温度读取、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, get mode等操作。
